title: The Most Passive Online Business No One Talks About
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: Niche filter-based directory websites
idea.one_liner: Find low-competition, high-demand local niches via Ahrefs 'near me' long-tails, inurl:directory searches, Google Maps spam, Facebook group 'looking for' posts and Reddit, then build a clean directory around one specific filter and monetise with featured listings, ads, affiliates and lead gen
idea.offer: curated niche directory with useful filters
idea.revenue_model: featured listings ($10-30/month), display ads, affiliate links, lead sales

key_quotes.quote: First of all, directories can rank stupidly fast, especially if you're targeting the right keywords.
So the play is to build micro directories where the whole point is in the filter.
Something basic like featured listings cost 10 to 30 bucks a month.

claims.claim: Directories earn passively once set up
claims.quote: Set it up once and it starts generating ad revenue, affiliate clicks, paid placement, lead genen forms, whatever you want, and you don't have to refill it with Fritos.

claims.claim: Renaming RV park GBP with exact-match keywords lifts traffic
claims.quote: I do the same thing whenever I buy an RV park. I rename the Google business profile city, state, RV park.

acquisition_channels.details: long-tail near-me keywords, beat weak WordPress/Wix competitors
ask to be listed/featured as validation

ideas.delivery: Collect 10 real listings from Google Maps/Yelp/Reddit/Facebook; build MVP on Softr/Card/Notion/Airtable/Tally/Webflow within 24-48 hours
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR when listing sole traders and selling leads; DMCC Act/CMA rules on fake reviews and paid placement disclosure

idea.name: Rural mobile dog groomer directory
idea.one_liner: Directory of mobile groomers in rural areas with zip code, travel radius, pricing and availability badges
idea.revenue_model: lead gen, monthly featured listings, Mediavine ads

key_quotes.quote: And the big problem is they don't have groomers nearby, but people nearby know how to groom.

stated_problem.quote: They're tired of digging through all the same 40 vendors on The Knot that are just paying for top placement.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Directory of wedding vendors not on The Knot
idea.one_liner: List referral-only DJs, videographers, caterers, photographers and venues absent from The Knot/Zola/WeddingWire, charging a flat $20/month
idea.customer: couples planning weddings; independent wedding vendors

key_quotes.quote: Charge vendors a flat 20 bucks a month instead of $5,000 a year just to be found by cooler couples.

stated_problem.quote: Or trying to find a therapist who takes Medicaid and actually answers emails.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Directory of therapists who take Medicaid and reply to emails
idea.one_liner: Therapist directory filtered by insurance, waitlist status, languages and a tracked email reply-rate badge
idea.revenue_model: affiliate links to therapy marketplaces, paid profile upgrades and priority placement

key_quotes.quote: You can monetize with affiliate links to therapy marketplaces or you could even charge therapists to upgrade their profiles or to have priority placement.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK equivalent would filter NHS/insurer-accepted therapists; BACP/UKCP registration checks

stated_problem.quote: Most venues are forcing you to use their4 to60 plus dollar a plate catering, but there are places out there that let you bring your own.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Directory of event venues that allow outside food
idea.one_liner: List banquet halls, churches, barns and backyards that let you bring your own catering, scraped from Peerspace
idea.customer: people booking weddings and birthday venues

key_quotes.quote: You could use places like peers to find venues that already do this and scrape them from peers and add them to your site.

idea.name: Commercial kitchen rental space directory
idea.one_liner: Aggregate health-inspected kitchens for hourly rent by ghost kitchens, meal preppers and cottage bakers, filtered by rate, equipment, certification and insurance
idea.customer: food startups and cottage bakers; kitchen owners

key_quotes.quote: They need a health inspected kitchen to rent for 3 to four hours a week.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Food businesses using kitchens must register with local authority

idea.name: Bee removal directory
idea.one_liner: Build a bee removal directory where the keyword has very low difficulty and the ranking competitor looks outdated
idea.customer: homeowners with bee problems; bee removers

key_quotes.quote: I see a four keyword difficulty and a 5,300 search volume. This looks like an amazing opportunity actually, especially for a beginner.
